title: Add multi-supplier sourcing relationships for Products and SKUs
description: Add explicit master-data relationships that associate an existing Product, or one of its active SKU variants, with multiple existing Suppliers. The relationship is sourcing guidance only. It must not automatically select a supplier, approve a price, create a Purchase Quote or Purchase Order, rewrite historical purchasing records, execute production SQL, or deploy.
acceptance_criteria: Users can associate a Product or active SKU variant with multiple existing Suppliers and maintain supplier item code, purchase unit, minimum order quantity, lead-time days, active state and one optional preferred relationship.
The server validates Product, optional variant and Supplier references and rejects missing, deleted, inactive or mismatched records for new relationships.

Only one active preferred Supplier relationship is allowed for the same Product and optional variant; changing the preferred relationship is explicit and transactional rather than dependent on list order.
Duplicate active relationships for the same Product, optional variant and Supplier are rejected, while disabled historical relationships remain readable.
Product and Supplier detail workflows expose bounded sourcing lists and clearly distinguish product-level relationships from SKU-specific relationships.
The relationship does not automatically change Purchase Quote selection, Purchase Order supplier or price, inventory cost, or any historical document.
Existing Products and Suppliers without sourcing relationships remain valid and require no production backfill.

Unit/integration tests cover multiple suppliers, preferred uniqueness, invalid references, inactive relationships, SKU ownership validation and non-mutation of purchasing documents; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Open a Product or SKU and associate two existing Suppliers, marking exactly one relationship as preferred.
Disable a sourcing relationship and verify it remains visible as historical guidance but is not offered as an active choice and does not alter any Purchase Order.

human_gate.reason: Repository master-data relationship code and non-production test schema only; no automatic purchasing, production database action, deployment or release is authorized.
